issues.title: Organization Schema
issues.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD schema with name, logo, and contact info to help AI identify your business.
issues.fixCode:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "The AI workspace that works for you.",
  "url": "https://www.notion.so/",
  "logo": "https://www.notion.so/favicon.ico",
  "sameAs": [
    "https://twitter.com/yourhandle",
    "https://www.linkedin.com/company/yourcompany"
  ]
}
</script>
issues.explanation: The Organization Schema issue matters for AI visibility because it helps search engines and other artificial intelligence (AI) systems understand your business's identity and contact information. By adding this schema, you're providing a clear and standardized way for AI to recognize your company, similar to how a business card provides key details about a person. This improves your online presence and makes it easier for customers to find and interact with your business.

issues.title: FAQ Schema
issues.evidence: www.notion.so: FAQ content detected but no FAQPage schema. Questions: do?, do?, beautiful?
issues.recommendation: FAQ content detected but no FAQPage JSON-LD schema. Add FAQPage schema for better AI visibility.
issues.fixCode:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Ready to build something beautiful?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Paste the answer here."
      }
    }
  ]
}
</script>
issues.explanation: The FAQ schema issue matters for AI visibility because it helps search engines like Google understand the content and structure of a website's frequently asked questions (FAQ) section. By adding an FAQPage schema, a type of code that provides additional context, businesses can improve their website's visibility in search results and make it easier for users to find answers to common questions. This, in turn, can drive more traffic and engagement to the website, ultimately boosting its online presence and credibility.

- [Home](https://www.notion.so/)

issues.explanation: This issue matters for AI visibility because it affects how artificial intelligence (AI) systems, like search engines, understand and navigate your website. Essentially, this file is a simple way to communicate with AI systems and ensure your website is properly represented in search results and other online platforms.

issues.title: sitemap.xml
issues.recommendation: Create a sitemap.xml to help AI crawlers discover your pages.
issues.explanation: The absence of a sitemap.xml file matters for AI visibility because it makes it harder for search engines like Google to find and index all the pages on your website, which can negatively impact your online presence. Think of a sitemap.xml file like a map that helps AI "crawlers" (computer programs that browse the internet) discover and navigate your website's content. By creating a sitemap.xml file, you can improve the chances of your website's pages being found and displayed in search engine results, making it more visible to potential customers.

issues.title: Content Freshness
issues.evidence: www.notion.so: No dates found on 19 pages
issues.recommendation: Add 'last modified' dates to pages. AI assistants prefer fresh content.
issues.explanation: The issue of content freshness matters for AI visibility because search engines and AI assistants, like virtual helpers, prioritize showing users the most up-to-date and relevant information. By not having 'last modified' dates on pages, a website may appear outdated to AI systems, potentially lowering its visibility in search results. Adding these dates helps signal to AI assistants that the content is regularly updated, increasing the likelihood of it being displayed to users.

By adding a robots.txt file, a website can better control how its content is discovered and presented by AI-powered search tools, ultimately improving its online visibility and reach.
